{{Quote|Welcome to Kaller! How you liking it so far?|Captain Styles, during the Conquest of Kaller|<ref name="Kanan 1" />}}
'''Kaller''' was a terrestrial [[planet]]<ref name="No Disintegrations" /> with a complex climate<ref name="Hoth and Other Outer Rim Planets">{{EncyclopediaCite|Hoth and Other Planets in the Outer Rim}}</ref> located in the [[Kaller system]]<ref name="No Disintegrations" /> of [[the galaxy]]'s [[Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Kanan 2" /> It was the [[homeworld]] of the [[Kalleran]]s.<ref name="Kanan 1" />

==Description==
[[File:CalebDumeEscapesOrder66-Aftermath.png|left|thumb|300px|Kaller was a planet of snowy forests and cliffs.]]
Although Kaller was a cold [[planet]],<ref name="Kaller DB">{{Databank|kaller|Kaller}}</ref> the world, situated in a [[binary star]] [[Star system|system]], had complex seasonal variation that saw mild weather shift into extreme conditions within [[Standard day|days]], allowing Kaller to also be a temperate world.<ref name="No Disintegrations" /> The rapidly changing climate, a side effect of Kaller's binary star system, meant that Kaller could go from an extreme heat to a deep cold over the course of a few days.<ref name="Hoth and Other Outer Rim Planets" /> It was also situated at the intersection of three different [[hyperspace route]]s. Most Kallerans lived along [[Water|freshwater]] [[river]]s, building stone buildings in smaller towns and [[duracrete]] structures in cities.<ref name="No Disintegrations" />

==History==
===Age of the Republic===
During the [[Republic Era|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic]], Kaller remained an insulated world due largely to the native Kallerans' culture valuing individualism, rather than collective achievement. While the Kallerans formed local governments and economies, the world's lack of an organized planetary government opened it up for colonization and exploitation by galactic corporations and extraplanetary groups, like the [[Mandalorian]]s and [[Pyke]]s. Occupying regional colonies, these groups [[Mining|mined]] the mineral resources of the world, driving many of the Kallerans into the resource-poor regions where they were permitted to live in peace under their own leaders.<ref name="No Disintegrations" />

While Kaller hosted many different groups and [[species]], no offworlders ever held absolute sway over the majority of the planet. Local Kalleran leaders worked behind the scenes to create rivalries between the offworlders that would better serve Kalleran politics.<ref name="No Disintegrations" /> During the [[Clone Wars]],<ref name="Kanan 1" /> the planet was part of the [[Galactic Republic]]<ref name="Kanan 6" /> and was [[Battle of Kaller|targeted]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], with [[Count]] [[Dooku]] himself ordering [[General]] [[Kleeve]] to lead the conquest. After the general left the world of [[Kardoa]] to lead the [[Battle of Kaller|conquest of Kaller]],<ref name="Kanan 9">[[Kanan 9|''Kanan'' 9]]</ref> he oversaw the Separatist occupation of Kaller out of the [[Gamut Key's residence|compound]] of [[Gamut Key's village|village]] leader [[Gamut Key]].<ref name="Kanan 1" />

===End of the Clone Wars===
[[File:CloneOnKaller-Kanan1.png|thumb|right|250px|Clone troopers on Kaller after General Kleeve's retreat]]
In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Date note">As established by "[[Aftermath (episode)|Aftermath]]," the [[Battle of Kaller|Conquest of Kaller]] takes place concurrent to the execution of [[Order 66]], which is dated to [[19 BBY]] by ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''.</ref> [[Jedi]] [[Jedi Master|Master]] [[Depa Billaba]] and her [[Padawan]] [[Kanan Jarrus|Caleb Dume]] led their [[Depa Billaba's second battalion|battalion]] of [[clone trooper]]s against Kleeve's occupation of Kaller. Although Kleeve was forced into a retreat, the Kallerans were resistant to the campaign, seeing little difference between a Republic and Separatist occupation of the planet.<ref name="Kanan 1" /> After the [[Battle of Coruscant]], Kaller was again a battleground, with Billaba, Dume, and their [[Cloning|clones]] fighting [[battle droid]]s alongside the elite squad [[Clone Force 99]], which was the only reinforcement that could be sent due to the Battle of [[Coruscant]] which was the Republic’s capital world.<ref name="Aftermath" />

The execution of [[Order 66]] would see the betrayal of [[Clone Captain]] [[Grey (clone trooper)|Grey]] and Billaba's other clones. After she yelled for her Padawan to run, Billaba was killed by her own troops, and Dume was chased into the woods by [[Clone Sergeant]] [[Hunter]] and [[sniper]] [[Crosshair]] of Clone Force 99. Being the only member of his [[squad]] impacted by Order 66, Crosshair tried but failed to kill the Padawan, who escaped into the woods. Nevertheless, his report of the mission revealed that Dume had survived the order,<ref name="Aftermath" /> ensuring Grey's [[troop]]s searched for him in [[Plateau City]].<ref name="Kanan 2" />

===Age of the Empire===
During the [[Imperial Era]], the [[Galactic Empire]] took little interest in Kaller, seeing the planet as inconsequential,<ref name="No Disintegrations" /> but certain Imperials continued to press on the planet.<ref name="Kanan 6" /> Still, the Empire maintained no military presence in the Kaller system.<ref name="No Disintegrations" /> Key was named the provincial governor of Kaller with the Empire's support, but he grew to dislike the regime and the way certain Imperials demanded more and more of his world.<ref name="Kanan 6" /> During the [[mission to Kaller]], Dume, now going by the name "Kanan Jarrus," returned to the planet. Jarrus and the rest of his rebel crew, the [[Spectres]], clashed with Imperial [[stormtrooper]]s<ref name="Kanan 11">[[Kanan 11|''Kanan'' 11]]</ref> alerted to their presence on Kaller.<ref name="Kanan 9">[[Kanan 9|''Kanan'' 9]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Kaller first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: Kanan]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series, written by [[Greg Weisman]].<ref name="Kanan 1" /> It later appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'' series premiere "[[Aftermath (episode)|Aftermath]]."<ref name="Aftermath" /> Kaller's inclusion in the show came as a cue to the ''Star Wars: Kanan'' comic, due to the series premiere depicting the same events.<ref name="Trivia Gallery">{{SW|url=aftermath-trivia-gallery|text=Tech's Notes: "Aftermath" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 1}}</ref>

===Continuity===
While [[Order 66]] occurs during the day and involves Clone Force 99 in "Aftermath,"<ref name="Aftermath" /> its depiction is different in [[Kanan 2|''Kanan'' 2]]. During the night after Kleeve's retreat, Grey and [[Captain]] "[[Styles]]" lead the clone [[battalion]] against Dume and Billaba. After the death of the [[Jedi General]], Grey orders [[Rostu Squad]] and all other troops to search for Dume.<ref name="Kanan 2" />
